title.zh: 修改VPC边界防火墙的开关状态

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于修改VPC边界防火墙的开关状态。该VPC边界防火墙是防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的流量。打开VPC边界防火墙的开关后，高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的互访流量会受VPC边界防火墙防护。关闭VPC边界防火墙的开关后，VPC边界防火墙不再防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的互访流量。

调用本接口前，必须已经调用[CreateVpcFirewallConfigure](~~342893~~)接口创建了VPC边界防火墙。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This API call modifies the status of a VPC firewall. A VPC firewall protects traffic between two virtual private clouds (VPCs) that are connected by an Express Connect circuit. When the VPC firewall is enabled, it protects traffic between the two VPCs. When the VPC firewall is disabled, it no longer protects traffic between the two VPCs.

Before you make this API call, you must create a VPC firewall using the [CreateVpcFirewallConfigure](~~342893~~) API call.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API call is 10 for each Alibaba Cloud account. If you exceed the limit, your API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your API calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw modify-vpc-firewall-switch-status --lang zh --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --firewall-switch open --member-uid 2580394279020000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw ModifyVpcFirewallSwitchStatus --region cn-hangzhou --MemberUid 2580394279020000 --Lang zh --VpcFirewallId 'vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000' --FirewallSwitch open
